headline: martin-olivier/airgorah
abstract: A WiFi security auditing softwarehttps://crates.io/crates/airgorah Airgorah A WiFi security auditing software Installation    |    Usage    |    Credits Airgorah is a WiFi security auditing software that can capture nearby WiFi traffic, discover clients connected to access points, perform deauthentication attacks, capture handshakes and PMKIDs, and crack the password of access points. It is written in Rust and uses GTK4 for the graphical part. ⭐ Don't forget to put a star if you like the project! Legal ⚠️ Airgorah is designed to be used in testing and discovering flaws in networks you are owner of. Performing attacks on WiFi networks you are not owner of is illegal in almost all countries. I am not responsible for whatever damage you may cause by using this software. Requirements This software only works on linux. The graphical interface runs as a normal user (so it works under both X11 and Wayland). When a privileged operation is needed, it launches a small privileged agent (airgorah-agent) via polkit, which will prompt for authentication once. You will also need a wireless network card that supports monitor mode and packet injection. Installation The installation instructions are available here. headline: Tencent/LoopForge
abstract: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.https://loopforge.cn English · 简体中文 Two ways to work · Quick start · SOPs · Features · Local · FAQ · Docs https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8af401d9-1aae-427c-b4bc-455c12d17beb 80-second product tour (1080p, with sound). LoopForge is a self-hosted workspace where your team ships software with coding agents. Describe what you need to Main Bot in chat: it opens a Docker sandbox, checks out your repositories, delegates to project roles, and opens the PR. When a way of working proves itself, save it as an SOP (a standard workflow of agents, scripts and human gates) so the next requirement is delivered the same way, with review and approval built in. Coding-agent CLIs do the work: CodeBuddy, Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Antigravity, Kimi Code, Pi, DeepSeek Harness and ZCode. LoopForge adds the roles, sandboxes, checkpoints and history around them, all on your own infrastructure under the MIT license.
